title: Smoky Ethiopian Greens Tacos
description: A unique fusion of Ethiopian spices and Mexican flavors in a delicious taco. Gomen (Ethiopian collard greens) are slow-cooked in a smoky chipotle tomato sauce and served in tacos with lovely greens and your favorite toppings.

ingredients.name: Lovely greens (such as lettuce or cabbage)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chipotle powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chipotle tomatoes and gomen. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the gomen mixture onto a tortilla and topping with lovely greens.
